32-wombat-cubes.name: Wombat Cube Poop
32-wombat-cubes.idea: Wombats are the only animals known to make cube-shaped poop; stiff and stretchy sections of the last part of their intestine shape the corners as it dries.
32-wombat-cubes.title: Wombats poop CUBES
32-wombat-cubes.body: Wombats are the only animal known to make cube-shaped poop. Stiff and stretchy bands in the end of their gut squeeze the drying poop into corners. They can leave up to 100 cubes a night and stack them on rocks and logs to mark territory.
sources: Yang et al., Soft Matter (2021), Georgia Tech / University of Tasmania https://pubs.rsc.org/en/content/articlelanding/2021/sm/d0sm01230k

33-oxford-aztecs.name: Oxford Older Than Aztecs
33-oxford-aztecs.idea: Teaching at Oxford existed by 1096, while the Aztecs founded Tenochtitlan around 1325, over 200 years later.
33-oxford-aztecs.title: Oxford is OLDER than the Aztecs
33-oxford-aztecs.hook: Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire.
33-oxford-aztecs.body: Teaching at Oxford was happening by 1096. The Aztecs founded their capital, Tenochtitlan, around 1325, more than 200 years later. Oxford is still teaching today.
sources: University of Oxford, Introduction and history https://www.ox.ac.uk/about/organisation/history

34-taller-morning.name: Taller In The Morning
34-taller-morning.idea: Spinal discs lose water under gravity during the day, so people shrink about 1 cm by night and regain it while lying down; astronauts grow up to 5 cm in space.
34-taller-morning.title: You're TALLER in the morning
34-taller-morning.hook: You're about 1 cm taller when you wake up.
34-taller-morning.body: The soft discs between your vertebrae get squashed by gravity all day and lose water, so you shrink about 1 cm. Lying down at night lets them soak it back up. In space, astronauts can grow up to 5 cm.
sources: NASA, astronauts grow taller in space https://www.nasa.gov/missions/station/iss-research/
Tyrrell, Reilly & Troup, Spine (1985), circadian variation in stature https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/4049107/
